semanticReview.method: Seguimiento R33: nueva búsqueda y cotejo de fuente primaria; revisión previa queda preservada en review-history al completar el lease.
findings: くん is a treatment attached to a name rather than a personal pronoun. The official guidance classifies 君 as a 敬称, but its account is historically prescriptive.

Current uses vary by gender, age, status, closeness, and include women in workplaces. The source gives an older normative pattern for young male students and allows variation in honorifics; it does not support this contemporary distribution.
The article’s example forms and judgments are current and representative. No current usage corpus or primary study for these exact examples was located.
くん is not exactly “Mr.” and may be inappropriate in some relations. The official guidance distinguishes 君 from standard さん in some settings but does not substantiate all article judgments.
Revisión nueva: se amplió la búsqueda con consultas diferentes en portales lexicográficos/institucionales y se inspeccionaron los pasajes indicados en primarySourcesInspected.
